# Scoreboard

One row a day, written by the Report routine (`.claude/routines/report.md`) from production's aggregate counters, read-only: `play_counts` for the funnel and `daily_metrics` and the ledger for money. Only public, aggregate numbers go here; no person is ever named. The north star is funded cards shipped per week. The kill line is `docs/PLAN.md` §8: at least 25 distinct supporters and $200 gross in the 30 days after the first launch post.

Columns are 7-day totals ending that day: home loads, Dust loads, presses into the game, Dust sessions past 4 minutes, Dust day-1 returns, /contribute loads, contributions, cards shipped.

| Day | Home | Dust | Play presses | Dust 4 min | Dust D1 | /contribute | Contributions | Shipped |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-26 | 185 | 70 | 6 | 6 | 4 | 7 | 0 | 0 |

The baseline row was read by hand on 26 October 2026. No launch post had gone up, and no card had shipped since 10 October.
